data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jalala', meaning to be exalted or glorified. This name is used to describe Allah (swt) in the Quran and signifies grandeur, majesty, and power. The name AlJalil carries the meaning “The Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJalil usually hope their child will grow to embody the exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlJalil total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
